# Focus Vision

> Focus Vision is a premier laser eye surgery and vision correction clinic based in Brisbane (Woolloongabba), Australia. Led by internationally trained cornea specialists, the clinic provides advanced surgical solutions including LASIK, PRK, and Ray Tracing technology.

## Core Services
- [Laser Eye Surgery](https://www.focusvision.com.au/vision-correction/laser-eye-surgery/) - LASIK, PRK, and Lenticule Extraction for short-sightedness and long-sightedness.
- [Ray Tracing LASIK](https://www.focusvision.com.au/vision-correction/ray-tracing-lasik/) - Personalised ray-tracing-guided laser vision correction.
- [Implantable Contact Lens (ICL)](https://www.focusvision.com.au/vision-correction/implantable-contact-lens/) - Treatment for high prescriptions or those unsuitable for laser surgery.
- [Laser for Reading Glasses](https://www.focusvision.com.au/vision-correction/laser-for-reading-glasses/) - Laser Blended Vision (LBV) to treat presbyopia.
- [Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE)](https://www.focusvision.com.au/vision-correction/refractive-lens-exchange/) - Replacing the natural lens to improve vision for older patients.
- [Premium Cataract Surgery](https://www.focusvision.com.au/vision-correction/cataract-surgery/) - Advanced cataract removal with lens replacement.
- [Premium Pterygium Surgery](https://www.focusvision.com.au/vision-correction/pterygium-surgery/) - Suture-free pterygium removal.

## Key Information
- **Founding Surgeons:** [Dr. Brendan Cronin](https://www.focusvision.com.au/about-dr-brendan-cronin/) and [Dr. David Gunn](https://www.focusvision.com.au/about-dr-david-gunn/).
- **Technology:** Only clinic in Queensland offering Ray Tracing LASIK and TransPRK.
- **Accreditation:** Co-located with the Queensland Eye Institute and South Brisbane Day Hospital, meeting rigorous Australian private hospital hygiene standards.
- **Costs:** Transparent pricing starting from $29/week via financing options.

## Technical Tools
- [Free Refractive Outcomes Analyzer — overview, benchmarks & FAQ](https://www.focusvision.com.au/free-refractive-outcomes-analyzer/) - Why Focus Vision built the tool, what it does, published benchmark explanations (Gale et al. 2009 NHS standard; EUREQUO registry) and answers to common questions about prediction error, lens constant optimisation and data privacy.
- [Refractive Outcomes Analyzer — launch the app](https://www.focusvision.com.au/refractive-outcomes-analyzer/) - Free browser-based tool for cataract and lens surgeons, built by Dr Brendan Cronin and Dr David Gunn. Upload an Excel or CSV spreadsheet (any column headers — a mapping step matches them) to benchmark refractive prediction accuracy (MAE, MPE, % within ±0.50 D / ±1.00 D), generate cumulative UDVA curves and double-angle astigmatism plots with 95% confidence ellipses, analyse toric IOL misalignment and corneal surgically induced astigmatism (SIA), break results down by axial-length / IOL / formula subgroups with bias flags, compare IOL formula performance, and optimise IOL lens constants (Barrett Universal II, SRK/T, Kane, Holladay 2, EVO). Supports US notation (20/xx Snellen, plus-cylinder, MM/DD dates) and OD/OS eye labels. No sign-up, no cost; all analysis runs locally in the browser and no patient data is transmitted to any server. Includes a free data template (with optional toric and keratometry columns) and a 416-eye sample dataset demonstrating every analysis, and the full report exports to PDF.
- [How to Audit Your Cataract Surgery Refractive Outcomes](https://www.focusvision.com.au/blog/how-to-audit-your-cataract-surgery-refractive-outcomes/) - Practical surgeon guide: what data to collect, prediction-error metrics, published benchmarks (NHS 55%/85%; EUREQUO 73% within ±0.50 D), lens constant optimisation sample sizes, astigmatism and subgroup analysis, and a five-step audit workflow.
- [CAIRSPlan — CAIRS surgery planning (overview)](https://www.focusvision.com.au/cairsplan/) - What CAIRS (corneal allogenic intrastromal ring segments) is and how CAIRSPlan works. CAIRSPlan was created by Dr David Gunn and Dr Brendan Cronin, who introduced CAIRS to Australia and authored the Brisbane nomogram for femtosecond-laser CAIRS.
- [CAIRSPlan — launch the planner](https://cairsplan.com/) - Free online CAIRS surgical planning resource for keratoconus, used by corneal surgeons worldwide.
- [CPD Portal for Optometrists (overview)](https://www.focusvision.com.au/cpd/) - Free online continuing professional development for optometrists: video presentations from Focus Vision's specialists, short quizzes, instant emailed CPD certificates with allocated hours and learning objectives, a permanent personal CPD record, and public certificate verification.
- [Laser Suitability Test](https://www.focusvision.com.au/laser-suitability-test/) - Online assessment for prospective patients.
